incidents.text: Amir Al Ammari (Iraq) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
Brilliant finish! Kylian Mbappe (France) perfectly collected a pass on the edge of the penalty area from Michael Olise, then produced a nice strike into the left side of the goal. The score is 1:0.
That's the end of the game for Aymen Hussein, who is replaced by Ali Al Hamadi (Iraq).
Goal - 2:0! Ousmane Dembele laid the ball off to Kylian Mbappe (France), who shot from close range into the bottom right corner, leaving the goalkeeper helpless.
The game has come to an end for Zaid Ismaeel. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Youssef Amyn (Iraq).
Graham Arnold decides to make a substitution. Zaid Tahseen will be replaced by Rebin Sulaka (Iraq).
Goal! Michael Olise produces a great pass that finds Ousmane Dembele (France) inside the penalty area, who takes advantage of the situation to rifle a shot into the bottom left corner. 3:0.
Michael Olise comes off the pitch to be replaced by Rayan Cherki (France).
A substitution has been made. Ousmane Dembele is replaced by Desire Doue (France).
Here is a change. Amir Al Ammari is going off and Graham Arnold gives the last tactical orders to Aimar Sher (Iraq).
Here comes a substitution. Marko Farji (Iraq) is brought on as a substitute for Ibrahim Bayesh.
The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Maghnes Akliouche (France) replaces Bradley Barcola.
Didier Deschamps prepares a substitution. Jules Kounde is replaced by Malo Gusto (France).
The referee allows time for a substitution. Kylian Mbappe will be replaced by Marcus Thuram (France).
